Method of Attack: Trojan masquerades as Adobe Flash Player installer, installs TeamViewer on infected computer, then contacts server to allow attackers to connect and take over infected computer via TeamViewer
Malware enables attackers to take control of computers via TeamViewer
Attack Vector: Trojan installation masquerading as Adobe Flash Player installer
Indicators of Compromise: Server IP address located in USA
Reports of attackers originating from Chinese IP addresses
Victims listed in leaked account dumps
